prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side-view game sprite sheet. Create exactly EIGHT distinct sequential frames in a precise 4-column by 2-row equally spaced grid, left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Truly transparent background, no text, no gridlines, no numbers, no shadows outside the sprite. All cells identical size with generous transparent gutters. Fixed camera straight side view. Each frame ground contact is on the same line at 85% of its cell height, centered on same X. Entire trap including stakes/roots fits inside each cell, no clipping. Hand painted crisp fantasy game art matching the supporting reference image, dark contour, readable at small size, no blurry glows. Animation phase frames1-5 is growth/unfolding and installation; frames6-8 are fully deployed dangerous state. Keep final footprint fixed after frame5; do not enlarge the whole artwork to fake growth. A golden leaf flower rooted in mossy soil. Start a closed golden seed-pod, sprout a short stalk and folded ivory-gold leaves, leaves slowly unfold into a radiant but physically solid golden four-petal flower with visible amber stamens and serrated leaves, and finally three subtle armed attack/twitch poses of petals flexing forward. Reference image lower row second object defines appearance and palette. Do not draw an aura or energy circle.
